defects.evidence: independent_validation.windows_unittest='51 tests; 35 failures and 1 error'; wsl_unittest='51 tests; 26 failures'; windows_ruff='15 violations'; origin_acceptance=false; observed_defects lists fixture/platform failures
defects.reason: Independent validation shows the gate under review does not behave as specified: 51 tests with 35 failures+1 error on Windows and 26 failures on WSL, plus 15 Ruff violations. Cross-host disagreement and origin_acceptance=false mean no PASS path, required_behavior claim, or integration decision can be trusted until the suite is green on both hosts.

defects.evidence: put_exclusive: 'directory = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)' then os.fsync(directory); observed_defects: 'put_exclusive calls os.open on a directory and raises PermissionError on Windows'
defects.reason: put_exclusive opens the parent directory with os.open(..., O_RDONLY) and fsyncs it; on Windows this raises PermissionError, so --emit cannot reliably write the canonical verdict on a required evidence host.

defects.evidence: audits() verifies AUDIT_KEYS, owner strings, and membership hashes via file_bytes(ctx.evidence, ...); no crypto; PRESERVED_LIMITATIONS admits internal receipts are not proof of contents yet treats co-located audits as the remedy
defects.reason: Dual 'owned' audits are only schema+string owner fields inside the same attacker-writable evidence tree; there is no signature, out-of-band attestation, or separate trust root. A complete forged evidence directory (manifest, receipts, logs, audits, reviews, dispositions, PR bodies) can still reach PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY while preserving accepted=False and BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED.

defects.evidence: pr_body(): missing = [value for value in required_hashes if value not in body]; required_hashes mix 40- and 64-hex values into freeform body text
defects.reason: Published PR-body hash binding is substring containment ('value not in body'), not structured/canonical embedding. Distinct required digests can be satisfied by accidental or crafted overlapping hex text without a verifiable binding section, weakening the claimed acyclic hash chain at the publication surface.

defects.evidence: reviews(): require(type(review['status']) is str and review['status']); dispositions allow DISPOSITIONS including 'deferred-owner-bound'; no check that blocking_gaps are empty or fixed-in-candidate
defects.reason: Final review 'status' is any non-empty string; blocking_gaps/dissent need only appear in the disposition table (including deferred-owner-bound). Negative or blocking reviews do not fail the gate, so PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY can coexist with unresolved blocking review content.

defects.evidence: file_bytes: require(0 < size <= limit, 'evidence file outside byte bound'); observed_defects: 'zero-byte successful diff logs are rejected... and mask later checks'; 'baseline fixture failures make many expected later-verdict tests non-isolated'
defects.reason: file_bytes rejects size==0, so legitimate zero-byte successful logs (e.g. clean diff-check) cannot bind; early Refused/INCOMPLETE also prevents isolated evaluation of later checks, matching the non-isolated baseline fixture failure pattern.

defects.evidence: freeze_block/ _host_block: WSL repo must startswith('/') and not startswith('/mnt/'); observed_defects: 'test fixtures feed a /mnt path where production requires native WSL POSIX paths'
defects.reason: WSL host path policy forbids /mnt aliases while fixtures feed /mnt paths; production predicate and tests disagree, so green intent cannot be inferred from current suite results.

defects.evidence: evaluate(): try/except ends before verdict construction; then 'if status == "PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY": require(all(...)); return verdict'
defects.reason: After setting status PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY, evaluate() calls require(all checks PASS) outside the Abort/Refused handler; a Refused there escapes without emitting the mandated single canonical FAIL/INCOMPLETE verdict record.

defects.evidence: dispositions(): for fixed-in-candidate only HEX64/HEX40 format require; no git/object/evidence lookup
defects.reason: fixed-in-candidate dispositions only check hex format of evidence_sha256; they do not prove the digest exists in the frozen candidate, artifacts, or membership maps.

defects.evidence: main(): --now -> utc(args.now) passed to evaluate; deadline/quota compare against ctx.now
defects.reason: CLI --now override can move evaluation across quota freshness and deadline-reserve predicates; unsafe if used outside hermetic tests.

defects.evidence: put_exclusive except BaseException: raise without os.unlink(path)
defects.reason: put_exclusive does not unlink the O_EXCL partial file on write failure; retries can spuriously fail closed on a leftover path.

defects.evidence: reviews() latest_receipt loop skips clean-cgroup and never reads audit created_utc
defects.reason: Review timing is checked only against latest host-check finished_utc, not against owned-audit created_utc, so audits could postdate the reviews that claim to bind them.

required_checks: Fix put_exclusive Windows directory durability (no O_RDONLY dir open that PermissionErrors) and re-run emit tests on Windows.
Allow or specially-case authenticated zero-byte logs where exit_code/observed imply empty success; stop early bound failures from orphaning later assertions (isolate fixtures).
Replace /mnt fixture paths with native WSL POSIX paths (and native Windows paths) matching freeze/receipt predicates.
Drive windows+wsl unittest to 0 failures/errors and clear or justify all 15 Ruff findings; pin SHA256 of passing logs.
Replace PR-body 'digest substring in text' with structured canonical binding (e.g. required JSON/YAML block or labeled lines whose canonical serialization is hashed).
Constrain review.status to an allowlist; define whether any blocking_gaps/deferred items forbid PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY.
Require cryptographic or out-of-band dual-owner audit attestation, or downgrade claims so co-located audits are not treated as independent ownership.
Wrap final PASS invariant require() so violations emit INCOMPLETE/FAIL verdict bytes, never an uncaught exception.
Verify fixed-in-candidate evidence_sha256 against frozen tree/artifacts; add adversarial tests for forged evidence bundles and substring-hash PR bodies.
Re-verify proposal_sha256/test_source_sha256/recovery hashes independently; do not trust packet-embedded digests.
reservations: No tools or execution were used; source/SHA claims and independent_validation summaries are untrusted packet data only.
Even a green construction PASS must not be read as scientific admission, full-gate equivalence, merge authority, or origin acceptance (origin_state remains unknown/recovered).
Self-attested evidence can satisfy this design class of gate; residual false-PASS risk remains until ownership and PR-body binding are strengthened.
Deadline/reserve and quota clocks make near-deadline PASS impossible by policy; that is fail-closed but can be confused with implementation failure.
Cross-host failure-count mismatch (35 vs 26) implies unrepaired platform-specific bugs beyond shared fixture debt.
strengths: Manifest argv is recorded but never executed; fixed git plumbing only.
Fail-closed posture: unresolved placeholders, schema drift, missing artifacts, and broad Exception -> INCOMPLETE/FAIL rather than PASS.
Hard-codes scientific_admission=BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED, accepted=False, merge_authority='Lucas alone', and disclaims full-gate equivalence on receipts.
Strict canonical JSON, duplicate-key rejection, nonfinite number rejection, symlink/escape checks on evidence reads.
Host path form checks separate native Windows vs native WSL and reject /mnt executing-path claims.
Hash-binding order is explicitly acyclic in design commentary; reviews must bind gate receipt and audit digests and postdate cited check receipts.
review.summary: Recovered publication_gate.py is a fail-closed evidence verifier by intent, but independent validation shows majority unit-test failure (26–35/51), Windows emit breakage, and several integrity gaps that can yield undeserved PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY on a forged or weakly bound evidence bundle. Treat as untrusted salvage: repair before any lead-review promotion; no acceptance, publication, or scientific authorization.
